name: Gap direction set, then a 38% retracement that turns
why: The overnight gap is repositioning that tends to continue into the cash session (gap-agree cascade). Buy (sell) a 38.2% give-back of the move from the open once it turns. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_sources.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1 && ((sign(gap) > 0 && (hod - px) >= 0.382 * (hod - open) && px > open && cl(5,1) > op(5,1)) || (sign(gap) < 0 && (px - lod) >= 0.382 * (open - lod) && px < open && cl(5,1) < op(5,1)))
